title: Clean layout
body: The layout for this is clean, and the developer was responsive and helpful. If I had the budget for this app I would definitely spend more time setting it up to see just how good it can be. If you can afford the subscription I would definitely recommend trying this.
author: wild er ness

title: No financial backend for plan management
body: It’s like Hotel California. You can sign up but never get out. There is no plan management and the don’t tell you how to cancel subscription. Be warned! They are taking you for a ride. Helpdesk is great and quick to reply but does not find a solution. All is good luck finding, it’s your job. But when it comes to collecting money they know exactly how and where… It’s not helpful at all!
author: BillyBeeman

title: Wonderful support
body: The app developer Andy was amazing and patient helping me troubleshoot an issue with syncing my calendars, Im really looking forward to use the app, I love the idea of a visual calendar for my neurodivergent brain and separation for my to dos from my appts and schedule.
author: Emmy_____

title: Inappropriate icons
body: I had to delete this app straight away as a sober person… It suggests little icons to match whatever scheduling input I wrote… I put drink water and it showed a sign of a bar with a mug of beer?????? No.
author: etta1991
